Hi Paul, thank you for verifying. I can help with your oil change. Which branch would you like? Oakville has free maintenance times on November 17, 18 and 19, but nothing shown on November 24 yet.

About the car you are buying: I can't share another person's name, visits, or repair records, even with the plate. The seller would need to contact us directly. Before you buy, you can also ask the seller for the service records or check with the seller's own dealer.
